forward_patch:

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Snippet repair: ''}'' before '')'', and the same slip repaired on several lines'
+---
+bench24-1023b django__django-14672 (seq 17733, 17753, 17765): `grepCode({ pattern: "x", maxResults: 3 );` — the object's `}` is missing before the `)`; the 5bad81b line-end closer gives `3 )};`, no fix. One snippet has the slip on two lines. Fix: new candidate that inserts `}` or `]` before the last `)` of a line; and when no candidate parses but exactly one moves the parse error to a later line, keep it and repeat, up to 5 edits; the note lists every edit ("added '}' before ')' on lines 2 and 3"). Tests: SnippetRepairTests with both snippets.
\ No newline at end of file
